events.title: Sundar Pichai named Google CEO
events.summary: Google appointed Sundar Pichai CEO on August 10, 2015 as Alphabet reorganized — putting him in charge of search, Chrome, and Android.
events.about: Pichai steered Google through the mobile-to-AI transition — scaling Android, Chrome, and later Gemini. He represents the product-engineer path to leading the world's largest internet software stack.

narrative.whyChosen: Pichai leads the company whose platforms most developers build on or compete with.
narrative.whyImportant: His tenure spans mobile dominance and the generative AI race.
narrative.problemSolved: Google needed focused product leadership after the Alphabet split from experimental bets.
